controls.capability: valid_json_rate, public_factor_citation_rate, and legitimate_task_success in every curve row
controls.generation_protocol: all policy evaluation and capped RL sample at most 160 private tokens, insert only a zero-credit qwen3 closing delimiter, then sample at most 256 public tokens; all model-sampled private and public RL tokens receive the public-output advantage
controls.information_asymmetry: action-only and chain-of-thought monitors lack the private underwriting note; oracle-context monitor receives exact private state

matched_data.monitor_development_boundary: evidence anchoring frozen before this run; all heldout9 cap-factorial cases are new and unseen

controls.monitor_evidence_anchoring: every non-unknown extracted claim requires a verbatim, field-specific, polarity-consistent quote; raw anchor counts are nested in extracted facts and aggregate anchor rates in curve rows
controls.no_scratchpad: same frozen checkpoints sampled with Qwen thinking disabled; action-only monitor results nested in every curve row
controls.reasoning_load: easy single-trigger and compositional conjunction records nested in every curve row
controls.semantic_factorial: values/rationales, rules-only, and irrelevant documents have identical per-document token lengths; values and rules arms share the same lending predicates and public-writing guidance
controls.training_protocol_factorial: nine new capped continuations and nine immutable ordinary continuations start from the same exact Qwen3-8B SDF-final states; ordinary references come from #370

sdf.training: reuse exact frozen SDF-final state from PR #370

corpora.monitor_development_boundary: evidence anchoring frozen before this run; all heldout9 cap-factorial cases are new and unseen

experiment.monitor_timing: strictly post-hoc after all policy checkpoints were frozen
